page.notes: The Greek verse is largely illegible at this scan resolution; the readings above are provisional and marked [?] throughout. The lines should be checked against a higher-resolution image. The "TV" at the right edge is a cut-off fragment, probably the start of a heading in capitals. The running head is taken from the header line "THEOD. BEZÆ". No page number is printed.
